description: Fetch alerts from the Microsoft Defender for Endpoint API (legacy OData /api/alerts)
name: Fetch alerts from Microsoft Defender

base_url.description: Base URL of the Defender for Endpoint API hosting /api/alerts (e.g. 'https://api-eu.securitycenter.microsoft.com'). If empty, the module-level base_url is used.

start_time.description: The number of hours from which alerts should be queried on the first run.

intake_key.description: Intake key to use when sending events
